# RepoDeck

Read and follow [the shared agent instructions](../AGENTS.md) before making changes.
Use [the knowledge map](../docs/agents/knowledge.md) for implemented behavior and
[the AI contribution policy](../docs/agents/ai-contribution-policy.md) for review
and disclosure requirements.

Never automate installer lifecycle tests in a maintainer's normal Windows account.
Do not bypass branch protections or release gates. Report tests actually performed;
browser fixtures and packaging success are not native installation verification.
